lines.trans: Unfold the paper along the original crease so the charcoal lines stay crisp, Zhou.
Oh, what a charming portrait—five young friends sitting beneath our courtyard shade tree!
There is my aunt pouring tea beside the open shutters of Room Nine!
And on the left with a violin under his chin sits number ten!
Beside him sits a young man holding this exact brass compass—my old map professor!
Who are the other two smiling neighbours holding plates of cake at table one?
Look at the tiny caption pencilled along the lower margin of the sketch, Zhou.
Friday Tea Crew, May: five chairs today, twenty-four chairs when we meet again!
They dreamed of twenty-four chairs around these stones thirty summers before you ordered them!
Do you hear that, Song?! My accidental chair order fulfilled a thirty-year prophecy!

words.gloss: fulfil; come true; realize (a dream, wish, or prophecy)

lines.trans: Let us frame this charcoal sketch right above the walnut piano, Zhou.

words.gloss: measure word for paintings, sketches, maps, and cloth

lines.trans: Wait—look under the tissue paper at the very bottom of the tin box!

words.gloss: press down; weigh down; pin underneath

lines.trans: See you tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng fāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正上方 ('the space right above').

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

examples.text: 书桌上方挂着一盏暖黄色的灯。
examples.trans: A warm yellow lamp hangs directly above the desk.

related.gloss: the space right above (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià ba. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下巴 ('a chin'). Neutral tone on the second syllable.

examples.text: 那位邻居把小提琴轻轻夹在下巴底下，准备拉琴。
examples.trans: That neighbour tucked the violin gently under his chin, getting ready to play.

examples.text: 老陈摸了摸下巴，仔细看着账本上的房间号码。
examples.trans: Chen stroked his chin and looked closely at the room numbers in the ledger.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù xiǎo xīn. Literally 'not careful'; placed before a verb to mean 'by accident / inadvertently'.

examples.text: 我刚才不小心把水洒在桌子上了。
examples.trans: I accidentally spilled water on the table just now.

examples.text: 他没戴眼镜，不小心看错了日期。
examples.trans: Without his glasses, he accidentally misread the date.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí sì. Cardinal number twenty-four ('two tens four'); followed by a measure word before nouns.

examples.text: 一天有二十四个小时。
examples.trans: There are twenty-four hours in a day.

examples.text: 两打茶杯一共是二十四个。
examples.trans: Two dozen teacups come to twenty-four in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ. Cardinal number 5.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天一天 ('all day today').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Third-person plural pronoun for male or mixed groups.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Used for pouring tea, water, or juice into a cup or pot (倒茶 'pour tea').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.en: so as not to; lest; to avoid
meanings.note: miǎnde — conjunction introducing an undesirable consequence that the preceding action seeks to prevent; slightly more conversational than 以免.

examples.text: 我们先把资料准备好，免得耽误他的时间。
examples.trans: Let's prepare the materials first, so as not to waste his time.

examples.text: 你快点跟她解释清楚，免得产生误会。
examples.trans: Hurry up and explain it clearly to her, lest there be a misunderstanding.

related.gloss: in order to avoid; lest (more formal)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

压.gloss: press down; weigh down; pin underneath

meanings.en: press down; weigh down; pin underneath
meanings.note: Pinyin: yā. Action verb for pressing from above or holding flat under an object (压着 'pinned/resting underneath').

examples.text: 快看铁盒子最底下的薄纸下面，还压着一个小方信封！
examples.trans: Look underneath the tissue paper at the very bottom of the tin box—a tiny square envelope is tucked underneath!

examples.text: 老陈拿了一块光滑的鹅卵石，把桌上的图纸压稳。
examples.trans: Chen took a smooth river pebble to weight the drawing paper down steadily on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán lái. Marks an 'aha!' discovery ('so it was X all along!').

examples.text: 原来星期五的神秘客人一直睡在我阁楼屋顶下面。
examples.trans: So our mystery Friday caller was sleeping under my attic roof all along.

examples.text: 原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
examples.trans: So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lìng wài. Before a number + measure word, means 'the other…' (另外两把 'the other two chairs').

examples.text: 这六把椅子放院子，另外六把放屋里。
examples.trans: Put these six chairs in the courtyard and the other six indoors.

examples.text: 我买了一袋苹果，另外还买了一罐果酱。
examples.trans: I bought a bag of apples, and in addition a jar of jam.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng jiàn. Result compound: 听 ('listen') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually hear'.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 关上木窗就听不见外面的车声了。
examples.trans: Close the wooden window and you cannot hear the street traffic.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wā. Expresses admiration or delight.

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tú. Combines 地 ('earth/land') + 图 ('chart/drawing'); measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 幅 (fú).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 小晴在手绘地图上用红笔标出了过桥以后的绿药店。
examples.trans: On the hand-drawn map, Qing marked the green pharmacy past the bridge in red pen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. First-tone jiā: hold something pinched between two surfaces, such as under one's arm (夹在胳膊底下) or inside book pages.

examples.text: 周经理把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下走来走去。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth with the green guest book tucked under his arm.

examples.text: 她在旧书里夹了一片干树叶做书签。
examples.trans: She tucked a dried leaf inside the old book as a bookmark.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

实现.gloss: fulfil; come true; realize (a dream, wish, or prophecy)

meanings.en: fulfil; come true; realize (a dream, wish, or prophecy)
meanings.note: Pinyin: shí xiàn. Takes abstract goals, dreams, or promises as object (实现梦想 'realize a dream', 实现预言 'fulfil a prophecy').

examples.text: 周经理不小心多订的椅子，居然实现了三十年前的预言！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's accidental extra chair order actually fulfilled a thirty-year-old prophecy!

examples.text: 两兄弟终于实现了一起在小院喝星期五下午茶的心愿。
examples.trans: The two brothers finally fulfilled their wish of sharing Friday afternoon tea in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo tí qín. Combines 小 ('small') + 提 ('hold/carry in hand') + 琴 ('stringed instrument'); measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 三十年前，每个星期五傍晚他都带着一把小提琴来九号房。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, every Friday evening he brought a violin to Room Nine.

examples.text: 老先生答应星期五带上小提琴，和宋老师的钢琴一起合奏。
examples.trans: The elderly gentleman promised to bring his violin on Friday and play a duet with Teacher Song's piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo duì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè) or 支 (zhī), e.g. 一支小队 ('a crew'). Warm, playful word for a small group of friends.

examples.text: 素描底下写着：“星期五下午茶小队，五月”。
examples.trans: Pencilled along the bottom of the sketch is: 'Friday Tea Crew, May'.

examples.text: 小晴、周经理和志豪组成了今天的梧桐巷寻宝小队。
examples.trans: Qing, Manager Zhou, and Hao formed today's Wutong Lane treasure-hunt crew.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù shì. Adds emphatic certainty before a noun ('is the very one').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

meanings.note: Adverb jūrán ('unexpectedly').

examples.text: 你们居然在这儿直接吃饭吗？
examples.trans: Are you actually eating right here on set?

examples.text: 短短一天居然筹到了这么多钱！
examples.trans: In one short day they actually raised this much money!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎn kāi. Resultative verb joining 展 ('spread out, extend') + 开 ('open'), used for folded paper, maps, or cloth.

examples.text: 顺着原来的折痕把画纸慢慢展开，炭笔线条还很清楚。
examples.trans: Unfold the drawing paper slowly along its original crease, and the charcoal lines are still crisp.

examples.text: 志豪在公园长椅上把四张水彩卡片拼在一起展开。
examples.trans: On the park bench Hao spread the four watercolour cards out together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

幅.gloss: measure word for paintings, sketches, maps, and cloth

meanings.en: measure word for paintings, sketches, maps, and cloth
meanings.note: Pinyin: fú. Standard classifier for framed pictures, scrolls, sketches, and woven textiles (一幅素描 'a sketch', 一幅画 'a painting').

examples.text: 我们把这幅炭笔素描装进画框，挂在钢琴上方吧。
examples.trans: Let us put this charcoal sketch in a frame and hang it above the piano.

examples.text: 老教授送给客栈一幅手绘的梧桐巷水彩地图。
examples.trans: The old professor gifted the inn a hand-painted watercolour map of Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: In one's youth.

examples.text: 团队里有很多充满活力的年轻编导。
examples.trans: The team has many energetic young writer-directors.

examples.text: 年轻的时候多经历一些挫折其实是好事。
examples.trans: Facing a few setbacks while young is actually a good thing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián qīng rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个年轻人 ('a young person').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 巷子里来了不少喜欢老建筑的年轻人。
examples.trans: Many young people fond of historic architecture visit the lane.

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēi xiào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个微笑 ('a smile').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Locative noun shǒulǐ ('in hand').

examples.text: 大家都先放下手里的活。
examples.trans: Everyone put down the work in your hands first.

examples.text: 光杏子手里就握着不少艺人资源。
examples.trans: Xingzi alone holds plenty of artist contacts in her hands.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé hén. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào), e.g. 一道折痕 ('a crease'). Joins 折 ('fold') + 痕 ('mark').

examples.text: 顺着原来的折痕慢慢把画纸展开，别把纸撕破了。
examples.trans: Unfold the drawing paper slowly along its original crease so you do not tear it.

examples.text: 这张旧信纸在信封里折了三十年，折痕依然整整齐齐。
examples.trans: Folded inside the envelope for thirty years, this old note sheet still has crisp, neat creases.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ nán zhēn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个指南针 ('a compass'). Literally 'south-pointing needle'.

examples.text: 小晴手里拿着黄铜指南针，顺着梧桐巷往东走。
examples.trans: Holding the brass compass in hand, Qing walks east along Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 这个实心黄铜指南针埋在地下三十年，依然非常准。
examples.trans: Buried underground for thirty years, this solid brass compass is still remarkably accurate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Used for setting out plates, chairs, or flowers neatly (摆好).

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 桌子上摆好了四个蓝茶杯。
examples.trans: Four blue teacups are neatly set out on the table.

meanings.note: Pronounced jiàoshòu; placed after a surname when used as a form of address (e.g., 方教授 'Professor Fang').
Pronounced jiàoshòu (or jiāoshòu in older usage) as a formal transitive verb meaning 'to impart knowledge or skills'.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 小谷同学，先来认识一下学位评委的各位教授。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, come meet the professors on the degree committee first.

meanings.en: throw wide open; leave wide open
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng kāi. Describes gates or windows opened wide.

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 每天早上八点，小院木门准时敞开。
examples.trans: Every morning at eight, the wooden courtyard gates swing wide open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng. Compact locality noun placed after nouns (钢琴旁 'beside the piano', 窗旁 'by the window').

examples.text: 宋老师正坐在阳光房的钢琴旁微笑呢。
examples.trans: Teacher Song is sitting beside the piano in the sunroom smiling.

examples.text: 客栈大门旁挂着一块擦得发亮的铜牌。
examples.trans: Beside the inn's front gate hangs a brightly polished brass plaque.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 旁边位置 ('a spot beside').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个时期 ('a time').

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

examples.text: 不看纸条，他走进大门时我说什么？
examples.trans: Without my notes, what do I say when he walks in the gate?

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天一天 ('all day tomorrow').

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé tao mù. Rich dark hardwood prized for upright pianos and classic furniture (note neutral-tone tao).

examples.text: 擦干净以后，老钢琴的核桃木外壳亮极了。
examples.trans: After being wiped clean, the old piano's walnut wood case gleams.

examples.text: 这张核桃木书桌已经在房间里放了四十年。
examples.trans: This walnut desk has stood in the room for forty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 等等——小美这会儿正要把蛋糕端到他们那桌去。
examples.trans: Wait—Mei is taking the cake out to their table right now.

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mèng xiǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个梦想 ('a dream').

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

examples.text: 开一家温暖的院子咖啡馆一直是她的梦想。
examples.trans: Opening a cozy courtyard café has always been her dream.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ zi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把椅子 ('a chair').

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tàn bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支 (zhī), e.g. 一支炭笔 ('a charcoal stick/pencil'). Joins 炭 ('charcoal') + 笔 ('pen/brush').

examples.text: 慢慢展开画纸，免得上面的炭笔线条蹭花了。
examples.trans: Unfold the drawing paper slowly so the charcoal lines on it do not smudge.

examples.text: 这位制图员只用一支炭笔，就把五个朋友画得活灵活现。
examples.trans: With just a single stick of charcoal, the mapmaker sketched all five friends full of life.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà kuàng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个画框 ('a picture frame'). Joins 画 ('picture') + 框 ('frame').

examples.text: 我们把这幅炭笔素描装进核桃木画框里挂起来吧！
examples.trans: Let us put this charcoal sketch inside a walnut picture frame and hang it up!

examples.text: 木工店师傅做了一个大小刚好的实木画框。
examples.trans: The carpenter in the woodshop made a solid-wood picture frame of the exact right size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个盒子 ('a small box').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 这个小木头盒子装的是老照片。
examples.trans: This little wooden box holds old photographs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pán zi. Combines 盘 ('plate/tray') + nominal suffix 子 (zi); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 干净盘子先放五分钟，你们俩快到门口来听！
examples.trans: Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you—come listen at the door!

examples.text: 小晴把烤好的柠檬挞切开，整整齐齐摆在白瓷盘子里。
examples.trans: Qing sliced the baked lemon tart and arranged it neatly on white porcelain plates.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn. Combines 石 ('stone') + 板 ('slab/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 雨后的院子石板路干干净净，映着温暖的灯光。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard flagstone path is spotless and reflects the warm lamplight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng bǎn. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗板 ('a shutter').

examples.text: 外面的窗板都关着，所以在院子里谁也没发现！
examples.trans: The shutters outside are all closed, so nobody in the courtyard ever noticed!

examples.text: 还有六天：擦玻璃，刷窗板，烤柠檬蛋糕！
examples.trans: Six days left: clean the glass, paint the shutters, bake lemon cake!

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sù miáo. Measure word (量词): 幅 (fú) or 张 (zhāng). Joins 素 ('plain, white') + 描 ('to trace, to draw').

examples.text: 卡片背面是一幅用木炭画的建筑素描。
examples.trans: On the back of the card is a charcoal sketch of a building.

examples.text: 志豪大学时经常带着速写本在老街画素描。
examples.trans: In college, Hao often took his sketchbook to the old street to draw sketches.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn tiáo. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn). Joins 线 ('thread, line') + 条 ('strip').

examples.text: 罗盘上的线条刻画得非常精细。
examples.trans: The lines on the compass are engraved with exquisite detail.

examples.text: 他用铅笔勾勒出几根简单的线条，一座小院的轮廓就出来了。
examples.trans: He outlined a few simple lines with a pencil, and the silhouette of a courtyard emerged.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Verb/noun huā ('spend time/money').

examples.text: 我花了六年的时间学习电视节目制作。
examples.trans: I spent six full years studying TV production.

examples.text: 这笔宣传预算必须花在刀刃上。
examples.trans: This publicity budget must be spent where it counts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo. Colloquially read 2nd-tone báo when standalone ('thin cup/paper', opposite of 厚 hòu); literary compounds often use bó.

examples.text: 这种薄玻璃杯盛冰柠檬水最好看。
examples.trans: This kind of thin glass cup looks prettiest filled with iced lemon water.

examples.text: 春天的早晚还有点凉，别只穿一件薄外套。
examples.trans: Spring mornings and evenings are still chilly—don't wear just a thin jacket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Specifically used for reserving rooms, tickets, or restaurant tables (订房间).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
examples.trans: Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: cèng. Action of grazing, rubbing, or smearing.

examples.text: 那只流浪猫撒娇地蹭了蹭小美的裤腿。
examples.trans: The stray cat rubbed coquettishly against Mei's trouser leg.

examples.text: 他不小心在刚刷好漆的门框上蹭了一下，弄脏了袖子。
examples.trans: He accidentally scraped against the freshly painted doorframe and dirtied his sleeve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān yuán. Joins 边 ('edge') + 缘 ('hem, margin').

examples.text: 杯子的边缘缺了一个小小的口子。
examples.trans: There is a small chip on the edge of the cup.

examples.text: 这张旧地图的边缘已经磨损得非常厉害了。
examples.trans: The edges of this old map have become heavily frayed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè xiē. Plural of 这个, needing no extra measure word before the noun.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mí rén. Joins 迷 ('to fascinate, to bewilder') + 人 ('person').

examples.text: 夜晚的小院在柔和的灯光下显得格外迷人。
examples.trans: The courtyard at night looks especially charming under the soft lighting.

examples.text: 宋老师弹奏的钢琴曲有一种迷人的魅力。
examples.trans: The piano piece played by Teacher Song possesses a charming appeal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.en: reunite; meet again after years apart
meanings.note: Pinyin: chóng féng. Note second tone chóng ('again') here.

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铁 ('a piece of iron').

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

related.gloss: a piece of iron (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支铅笔 ('a pencil').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén pái. Combines 门 ('door/gate') + 牌 ('numbered plaque/plate'); measure word: 块 (kuài) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小晴惊讶地认出他来：“您是梧桐巷十号门牌小提琴店的老邻居？！”
examples.trans: Qing recognized him in surprise: 'Are you our old neighbour from the violin shop at number ten Wutong Lane?!'

examples.text: 老陈把擦得干干净净的铜门牌端端正正钉在大门旁边。
examples.trans: Chen nailed the freshly polished brass doorplate squarely beside the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn zhe. Preposition 顺 ('follow along in the same direction') + continuous particle 着 (顺着走廊吹 'blow down the hallway', 顺着木纹刷 'brush along the wood grain').

examples.text: 小晴顺着木纹薄薄地刷油漆，刷出来的窗板又平整又漂亮。
examples.trans: Qing brushed the paint thinly along the wood grain, giving the shutters a smooth, even finish.

examples.text: 顺着梧桐巷的青石板路一直往前走，就能看见九号房的木牌。
examples.trans: Walk straight along the flagstones of Wutong Lane and you will spot the wooden sign for Room Nine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yù yán. Joins 预 ('beforehand') + 言 ('words, to speak'). Can also function as a noun.

examples.text: 制图员教授当年预言，这棵银杏树会长得比屋顶还高。
examples.trans: The mapmaker professor predicted back then that this ginkgo tree would grow taller than the roof.

examples.text: 没想到那个古老的预言今天竟然成真了。
examples.trans: Unexpectedly, that ancient prophecy has actually come true today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
